title: Prime-torsion lisse constructibility on an affine smooth relative curve
statement: Let Lambda be a finite commutative ring, R a finite-type integer algebra, and f:X -> Spec R an affine morphism from an affine scheme, smooth of relative dimension one [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] [pqf-def-affine-morphism] [def-pc-scheme]. Let p be a prime number and F a finite locally constant sheaf of Lambda-modules on the small etale site of X [def-constructible-locally-constant], with p times its identity zero. For every compactification c of f [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification] and every integer q, the q-th cohomology sheaf of Rf_!^c(F[0]) is constructible [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves].

source.place: Tag 0GKY, lemma-loc-constant-shriek-rel-dim-1: finite etale prime-torsion argument; Tag 0GKX, lemma-constant-shriek-rel-dim-1

proof.text: The base is Noetherian. Smoothness makes the affine source X locally Noetherian, hence its coordinate ring is Noetherian. Transport F along X isomorphic to Spec Gamma(X,top). Pullback preserves finite local constancy and p times the identity equals zero. Apply the finite etale filtration theorem with exponent one, obtaining g:T -> X finite etale surjective of constant positive degree d prime to p, and finitely many disjoint affine clopens W_a with finite constant-quotient filtrations of g^*F.

source.place: Tag 0GKY, lemma-loc-constant-shriek-rel-dim-1: finite etale prime-torsion argument; Tag 0GKX, lemma-constant-shriek-rel-dim-1

proof.text: The trace composed with the unit on F is d times identity. The filtration theorem measures d over algebraically closed points, while the trace theorem asks for separably closed points: a finite etale algebra over a separably closed field is a product of copies of that field, and extension to an algebraic closure preserves this number of factors. Thus the trace-degree hypothesis holds. Bezout gives integers a,b with a*d+b*p=1; a times the trace retracts the unit because p annihilates F.

source.place: Tag 0GKY, lemma-loc-constant-shriek-rel-dim-1: finite etale prime-torsion argument; Tag 0GKX, lemma-constant-shriek-rel-dim-1

proof.text: Finite g is proper and direct image is exact. Its compactified derived shriek is therefore its ordinary direct image on single complexes. Compactification composition and independence identify the compact-support object on T with the compact-support image over X of g_*g^*F. Applying compactified shriek to the preceding unit and trace exhibits the desired object as a retract of this object on T.

source.place: Tag 0GKY, lemma-loc-constant-shriek-rel-dim-1: finite etale prime-torsion argument; Tag 0GKX, lemma-constant-shriek-rel-dim-1

proof.text: Each affine clopen W_a is affine and separated over the affine base, and smooth of relative dimension one by etale composition. Choose its compactification by Nagata. Its ambient scheme is proper over the Noetherian base, hence Noetherian, so the open immersion is quasi-compact as required by the constant-coefficient theorem. Apply the constant-coefficient relative-dimension-one theorem to each finite constant quotient. Induct along the finite filtration using the short-exact triangles and the triangulated property of constructible cohomology. The initial zero subobject has zero image, and the last, top subobject is isomorphic to the pulled-back sheaf.

source.place: Tag 0GKY, lemma-loc-constant-shriek-rel-dim-1: finite etale prime-torsion argument; Tag 0GKX, lemma-constant-shriek-rel-dim-1

proof.text: The finite disjoint-clopen decomposition identifies g^*F with the biproduct of the extensions by zero of its restrictions. Compose compactifications to identify their shriek images. Additivity preserves this finite biproduct; constructible cohomology is closed under finite sums. Finally homology preserves the trace retraction, and a retract of a constructible sheaf is constructible, as the kernel of one minus its projector. This proves the assertion for every degree and every prescribed compactification, including empty sources and zero sheaves.

from.place: Affine prime-torsion part of Tag 0GKY: the finite etale trace and constant-filtration argument. The parent separately proves annihilator devissage and open-cover gluing.

lean.statement:
theorem isConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf_prime_lisse_affine_curve_shriek
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra.FiniteType ℤ R]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffineHom f] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 f]
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hF : Scheme.IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf F) (hkill : p • 𝟙 F = 0)
    (c : Compactification f) (q : ℤ) :
    Scheme.IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf
      ((_root_.DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor
        (Sheaf (Spec (.of R)).smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) q).obj
        ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) c).obj
          ((_root_.DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor
            (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) 0).obj F)))
